axeViolations.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
axeViolations.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.45 (foreground color: #818892, background color: #fafbfc, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: bold). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.37 (foreground color: #9ea6b1, background color: #fafbfc, font size: 9.8pt (13px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

axeViolations.description: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space
axeViolations.help: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size because it is partially obscured (smallest space is 18.5px by 44px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 18.4px instead of at least 24px.
